description:
## Why

PKIX-9vnx.6 decomposition step 4. The parent's acceptance criterion 'At least one lint demonstrates parameter use (e.g., a max-serial-length parameter overrideable via OSCAL Profile)' requires both a parameter abstraction in the Lint trait AND a concrete parametric lint to demonstrate it.

There is no Parameter type or parametric mechanism in pkix-lint today. pkix-lint also has zero RFC-conformance Lint impls; the CABF lints are scheduled to move to pkix-lint-cabf. Introducing the parameter demo via a CABF lint would put the demo in the wrong crate. Solution: introduce the first RFC-conformance Lint in pkix-lint as part of this bead.

## What

1. New `LintParameter` type in `pkix-lint/src/lib.rs`:

```rust
pub struct LintParameter {
    pub id: Cow<'static, str>,        // e.g. "max-octets"
    pub label: Cow<'static, str>,     // human-readable
    pub default_value: Cow<'static, str>,  // serialized to a Cow<str>
    pub current_value: Cow<'static, str>,  // mutable; equals default on construction
}
```

(Exact shape TBD during implementation — alternative shapes considered should be filed as new beads if non-trivial.)

2. New trait method on Lint:

```rust
fn parameters(&self) -> &[LintParameter] { &[] }
fn set_parameter(&mut self, id: &str, value: &str) -> Result<(), ParameterError>
```

Default `parameters()` returns empty slice; default `set_parameter` returns UnknownParameter.

3. First RFC-conformance Lint in pkix-lint: `Rfc5280MaxSerialLengthLint`. Implements RFC 5280 §4.1.2.2 ('Conforming CAs MUST NOT use serialNumber values longer than 20 octets'). Parametric on `max-octets` (default 20). Demonstrates the parameter mechanism end-to-end.

4. Tests:
   - Default Lint accepts a 20-octet serial, rejects a 21-octet serial.
   - After set_parameter("max-octets", "16"), Lint rejects an 18-octet serial that previously passed.
   - set_parameter with unknown id returns error.

## Acceptance

- [ ] LintParameter type defined; rustdoc explains the OSCAL Parameter mapping (id → OSCAL `param.id`, label → OSCAL `param.label`).
- [ ] Lint trait gains parameters() + set_parameter().
- [ ] Rfc5280MaxSerialLengthLint implemented + 4+ tests.
- [ ] LintRunner::with_bundle_version + LintRunner::new accept Box<dyn Lint> with parametric lints.
- [ ] Citation includes RFC 5280 §4.1.2.2 URL.
- [ ] Full pkix-lint suite passes default + --features oscal + --all-features.

## Out of scope

- OSCAL Profile-side modify directive that overrides parameters — that's .6.5.
- Catalog Control emit of parameters — could land here or in .6.5 (interpreter's choice).

## Depends on

PKIX-9vnx.6.1 (trait metadata).
title: Lint parameter mechanism + first parametric lint
